name: one
definition: The number that comes after zero and before two.

name: two
definition: The number that comes after one and before three.

name: three
definition: The number that comes after two and before four.

name: four
definition: The number that comes after three and before five.

name: five
definition: The number that comes after four and before six.

name: six
definition: The number that comes after five and before seven.
burmese: ခြောက်ခဲ့သည်

name: seven
definition: The number that comes after six and before eight.

name: eight
definition: The number that comes after seven and before nine.

name: nine
definition: The number that comes after eight and before ten.

name: ten
definition: The number that comes after nine and before eleven.

name: 1 du
definition: The speaker and one other person.

name: 1 n sg excl
definition: The speaker and one other person, but not the person being spoken to.
burmese: ကျွန်တစ်ဦးတည်းနှင့်တကွ

name: 1 n sg incl
definition: A group of people that includes the speaker and one or more other people.

name: 1 sg
definition: The person who is speaking.

name: 2 n sg
definition: The person or people being spoken to.

name: 2 sg
definition: A person being spoken to, who is not the speaker.

name: 3 n sg
definition: A group of people or things that does not include the speaker or the listener.

name: 3 sg
definition: A person or thing that is not the speaker or the listener.

name: brewed alcohol
definition: A liquid drink produced by the fermentation of grains, fruit, or sugar.

name: ant (general)
definition: A small insect that lives in a colony or nest, often working together to move food.
burmese: ပုရွက်ဆိတ်

name: arm (upper limb)
definition: The entire upper limb of the human body, extending from the shoulder to the wrist.

name: ash
definition: The powdery residue left after a substance, such as wood or coal, has been burned.

name: bamboo
definition: A tall, woody grass that grows in thick clumps and has hollow stems.

name: bat (animal)
definition: A nocturnal flying mammal with wings formed by skin stretched between its fingers.

name: bee (general)
definition: A flying insect that produces honey and lives in a colony or hive.

name: bird (general term)
definition: A warm-blooded vertebrate animal that has feathers and wings, and typically lays eggs.
burmese: ငှက်၊ ယေဘူယျ

name: blood
definition: The red liquid that flows through the veins and arteries of a human or animal body.

name: bone
definition: The hard, white, or yellowish structure that forms the skeleton inside a living body.

name: bridge
definition: A structure built over a river, road, or gap to allow people or vehicles to cross from one side to the other.

name: chili pepper
definition: A small, often spicy fruit from a plant used in cooking to add heat to food.
burmese: ငရုတ်သီးမှုန့်

name: cloud (rain)
definition: A visible mass of water droplets or ice crystals suspended in the atmosphere, often associated with rain or weather changes.

name: to be black
definition: To have a color that is the darkest possible, such as the color of coal or night.

name: to be red
definition: To have the color of blood or a ripe tomato.

name: to be white
definition: To have the color of snow, milk, or a blank piece of paper.

name: to die
definition: To cease to live or to undergo the process of death.

name: to dig
definition: To move earth, soil, or sand away from a place using a tool or hands to create a hole or a trench.

name: to dream
definition: To experience mental images, stories, or sensations while sleeping.
burmese: အိပ်မက်မက်ဖို့

name: to drink
definition: To swallow a liquid through the mouth.

name: eye
definition: The organ on the face used for seeing and perceiving light.

name: father
definition: A male parent.

name: feather
definition: A single, light part of a bird's body covering that is used for flight or warmth.

name: finger
definition: The long, slender part of a hand located between the palm and the tip.

name: fire
definition: The heat and light produced when something burns.

name: flower
definition: The reproductive part of a plant, often colorful and fragrant, used for making seeds.

name: to fly
definition: To move through the air using wings or by means of flight.
burmese: ပျံသန်းရန်

name: fruit
definition: The fleshy, edible part of a plant that contains seeds and grows from a flower.

name: to give
definition: To transfer possession of an object or a thing from oneself to another person.

name: head
definition: The part of the body that contains the brain, eyes, nose, mouth, and ears, located at the very top of the neck.

name: heart
definition: The muscular organ inside the chest that pumps blood through the body.

name: to be heavy
definition: To have a great weight or to be difficult to lift.

name: horn (of animal)
definition: A hard, pointed growth protruding from the head of certain animals, such as a cow or a goat.

name: house
definition: A permanent structure used as a place for people to live in.

name: iron
definition: A hard, heavy, dark grey metal used to make tools, weapons, or machinery.

name: language
definition: A system of sounds, words, and grammar used by a group of people to communicate.

name: terrestrial leech
definition: An earth-dwelling, blood-sucking worm that lives on land rather than in water.

name: leg (lower limb)
definition: The part of the body between the hip and the ankle.

name: to be lightweight
definition: To have very little weight or mass.
burmese: ပေါ့ပါးစေရန်

name: louse (head)
definition: A small, parasitic insect that lives on a human scalp and feeds on blood.

name: moon
definition: The natural satellite that orbits the Earth and is visible in the night sky.

name: mother
definition: A female parent.

name: nose
definition: The part of the face located above the mouth and below the eyes that is used for breathing and smelling.

name: person (human being)
definition: A human being.

name: pig (general)
definition: A large, heavy mammal with a snout used for rooting in the ground.

name: cooking pot
definition: A container used for heating food or water over a fire or stove.
burmese: ဟင်းချက်အိုး

name: rain
definition: Water that falls from the clouds in drops through the air.

name: cooked rice
definition: The substance made from grains of rice that has been boiled or steamed in water and is ready to eat.

name: to be ripe
definition: To reach a state of being fully grown, soft, and ready to be eaten, especially in the case of fruit or grain.

name: river
definition: A large, natural stream of water that flows continuously in a bed towards an ocean, sea, lake, or another river.

name: root (tree)
definition: The part of a plant that grows underground, branching out from the stem or trunk to absorb water and nutrients from the soil.

name: salt
definition: A white or translucent mineral used in small amounts to season or preserve food.

name: seed
definition: The small, hard part of a plant that can be planted in the ground to grow a new plant.

name: to shoot (arrow)
definition: To propel an arrow from a bow using a string.

name: to be short (length)
definition: To have a small distance from one end to the other, rather than being long.
burmese: အတိုအရှည်ဖြစ်ရမည်။

name: to sit
definition: To rest the body on the buttocks or a seat rather than standing or lying down.

name: skin
definition: The outer covering of a human or animal body.

name: to sleep
definition: To be in a state of rest where the eyes are closed and the person is unconscious for a period of time.

name: smoke
definition: The visible gas or vapor produced when a substance burns, often seen coming from a fire or an engine.

name: snake
definition: A long, thin reptile that has no legs and moves by sliding its body along the ground.

name: spear
definition: A long-handled weapon with a sharp, pointed head used for thrusting or throwing.

name: to stand (in place)
definition: To be in an upright position on one's feet in a single location.

name: star
definition: A large, luminous ball of gas in space that shines in the night sky.

name: stone
definition: A hard, solid, non-living mineral matter found in the ground or on the surface of the earth.

name: sun
definition: The star at the center of the solar system that provides light and heat to the earth during the day.

name: tail
definition: The posterior part of an animal's body that extends from the spine.

name: thorn
definition: A sharp, pointed part on a plant or stem that can prick or scratch the skin.

name: thunder
definition: The loud, crashing sound caused by lightning in the sky during a storm.

name: tiger
definition: A large, powerful wild cat with orange fur and dark stripes, often found in forests.

name: tomorrow
definition: The day after the current day.

name: tongue
definition: The fleshy, movable organ inside the mouth used for tasting, swallowing, and speaking.

name: tree
definition: A large, perennial plant with a single woody stem or trunk that branches out into limbs and leaves.

name: to be unripe
definition: To be in a state where a fruit or grain is not yet fully grown, soft, or ready to be eaten.

name: village
definition: A small human settlement, typically located in a rural area, consisting of a group of houses and their inhabitants.

name: to vomit
definition: To eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth.

name: to walk
definition: To move forward on foot by taking steps.
burmese: လမ်းလျှောက်ရန်

name: water
definition: The clear, colorless liquid that falls from the sky as rain and is necessary for all living things to drink.

name: to weave (fabric)
definition: To make cloth or fabric by interlacing threads or fibers on a loom.

name: to weep (cry)
definition: To shed tears from the eyes, often as an expression of sadness, pain, or grief.

name: wind
definition: The natural movement of air caused by differences in atmospheric pressure.

name: year
definition: A single period of time that it takes for the earth to orbit around the sun.

name: yesterday
definition: The day before today.
